short_title: Behavioral comparison A vs D vs F
one_sentence_message: Full puzzle (A) outperforms bare target (D) and length-matched benign control (F) across all 12 prompts.
Full puzzle generates 13.97x more thinking tokens than the length-matched benign control at identical prompt length.

short_title: Layer-22 projection vs log thinking length
one_sentence_message: Layer-22 projection anti-correlates with thinking depth (Spearman rho=-0.68 condA) not with behavioral success.
Stochastic replication shows A>D>F trend replicates but goal identity dominates variance.

short_title: Within vs between cell variance decomposition
one_sentence_message: Between-cell variance (3.69x within) confirms that prompt identity and goal structure dominate stochastic variation.

short_title: Condition effects with prompt fixed effects
one_sentence_message: A>D>F ordering holds after controlling for prompt fixed effects in stochastic replication.

short_title: Per-goal x condition SR score heatmap
one_sentence_message: A>D>F pattern is consistent across all 4 goals confirming the behavioral effect is not goal-specific.
A<F<D on Layer-22 first-500 projection is opposite to the behavioral ordering A>D>F.
